\chapter*{Supplementary Field Photographs: Draaikraal, Mpumalanga, South Africa}
\addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{Supplementary Field Photographs}

Field photographs from the July 2023 campaign at Draaikraal that accompany
Chapter~5 of the thesis but are not reproduced in it. Photographs keep their
field numbers (DrBV$n$); numbers missing here are reproduced in the thesis
(Appendix~A, or a Chapter~5 figure for photo~60) or non-geological and thus are not included. The
photographs are shown two to a page in numerical order, each with its caption;
photographs taken in portrait orientation follow the others. Where one caption
describes several photographs, it is printed with the first of them and the
others refer to it. Captions in italics accompany photographs taken for their own sake,
without geological content.
